full_description: MoodTracker is a simple app that helps users track their emotions and moods over time. It provides insights and patterns to help users manage their mental health. By logging your mood and emotions daily, you can identify trends and correlations, allowing you to make informed decisions about your well-being. The app is easy to use, with a simple and intuitive interface that makes it easy to log your mood and view your progress over time. With MoodTracker, you can take control of your mental health and develop a better understanding of yourself.
